summary: BioMar France and BioMar Iberia are advancing sustainable soy sourcing practices in their aquaculture feed production. The initiative reflects the company's commitment to environmentally responsible feed manufacturing for the aquaculture sector across its European operations. The article highlights prácticas sostenibles (sustainable practices) with soy in feed production, positioning the divisions as leaders in sustainable aquaculture nutrition in their respective markets.
title: BioMar France y BioMar Iberia fomentan prácticas sostenibles con soja en la producción de piensos de acuicultura
title_en: BioMar France y BioMar Iberia fomentan prácticas sostenibles con soja en la producción de piensos de acuicultura

summary: BioMar CEO Carlos Diaz discusses the company's approach to gaining consumer acceptance for genetically modified fish oil products. Diaz suggests that successful market adoption requires engaging with consumer emotions and concerns beyond technical facts alone.
title: ‘Let’s address feelings, not facts’: BioMar CEO on why GM fish oil will win over consumers
title_en: ‘Let’s address feelings, not facts’: BioMar CEO on why GM fish oil will win over consumers

summary: BioMar Costa Rica has obtained ASC (Aquaculture Stewardship Council) certification, marking a significant step toward sustainable aquaculture practices. The certification demonstrates the company's commitment to environmental and social responsibility in feed production for the aquaculture sector in Costa Rica's region.  The certification aligns with industry standards for responsible aquaculture operations. title: BioMar Costa Rica da un paso clave hacia la sostenibilidad acuícola con la certificación ASC
